description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the LeaveEntitlementService component within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It includes multiple test cases to verify the behavior of leave entitlement management, such as retrieving strategies, Dao usage, entitlement calculations, and bulk operations.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing functionalities of LeaveEntitlementService in the OrangeHRM Leave plugin.

classes.name: TestEntitlementConsumptionStrategy
classes.description: A mock implementation of EntitlementConsumptionStrategy used for testing purposes.

classes.name: InvalidLeaveEntitlementConsumptionStrategy
classes.description: A placeholder class to simulate invalid class scenario for testing

methods.name: testGetLeaveEntitlementStrategy
methods.description: Tests that getLeaveEntitlementStrategy returns an instance of EntitlementConsumptionStrategy when configured correctly.

methods.name: testGetLeaveEntitlementStrategyNonExistClass
methods.description: Verifies that an Error is thrown if the configured class does not exist.

methods.name: testGetLeaveEntitlementStrategyInvalidClass
methods.description: Checks that a TypeError occurs when the configured class does not implement the expected interface.

methods.name: testGetLeaveEntitlementDao
methods.description: Verifies that getLeaveEntitlementDao returns an instance of LeaveEntitlementDao.

methods.name: testGetDeletableIdsFromEntitlementIds
methods.description: Tests the logic for filtering leave entitlement IDs that are deletable based on days used.

methods.name: getDeletableIdsFromEntitlementIdsDataProvider
methods.description: Provides data sets for the deletable entitlement IDs tests.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceWithDates
methods.description: Checks retrieval of leave balance with specific date ranges.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceWithOnlyEndDate
methods.description: Checks leave balance calculation when only the end date is specified.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceWithOnlyAsAtDate
methods.description: Verifies the leave balance calculation with only the 'as at' date, including different leave period configurations.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceWithOnlyAsAtDateLeavePeriodNotForced
methods.description: Tests leave balance retrieval when leave period mode is not forced and only 'as at' date is provided.

methods.name: testAddEntitlementForEmployeeAsNew
methods.description: Verifies adding a new entitlement for an employee, expecting new credit date and zero days used.

methods.name: testAddEntitlementForEmployeeAsAdding
methods.description: Tests adding an entitlement to an existing employee without deletion.

methods.name: testAddEntitlementForEmployeeAsAddingWhenDeletedAlsoThere
methods.description: Tests adding entitlement to an employee even when previous entitlements exist, including previous days used.

methods.name: testBulkAssignLeaveEntitlements
methods.description: Validates bulk assignment of leave entitlements to multiple employees.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Loads test fixtures data into the database.
